You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its Talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls use your Ranged Proficiency, and every Talent here counts toward your Ranged rank. You gain the Draw a Bead ❶ action.
Draw a Bead ❶ Concentrate
Choose one creature you can Observe and can reach with your bow.
Until the end of your next Opportunity:
your next bow Strike against that creature gains a +1 Situation bonus to the attack;
ignore the weapon's Unwieldy penalty for that Strike;
if that Strike Grazes, you choose the Zone it lands on instead of the defender.
